subject: russian_language
purpose: Reusable subject engine constraints for yearly official demo variants

answer_controls.single_word: strict text input: Cyrillic letters only, outer trim, case-insensitive, ё=е
answer_controls.phrase: strict text input: Cyrillic words with exact single spaces or confirmed compact alternative
answer_controls.unordered_digits: checkboxes; scorer accepts exact unique digit set only
answer_controls.matching_sequence: one select per lettered position; positional partial scoring only where year passport confirms
answer_controls.essay: paper or demo textarea; browser language assistance disabled; frozen demo result; expert-only official scoring

essay_gate: official word-count threshold must be confirmed by user/expert
not a copied/retold source without own commentary
dependencies: K1=0 forces K2=0 and K3=0 in both UI and scorer
K7-K10 confirmed findings set hard caps: 1-2=>2, 3-4=>1, 5+=>0
K7-K10 possible findings never lower the cap
built-in regex analysis is preliminary and never promotes context-dependent candidates to confirmed
technical spacing notices are not K8 findings and never change a cap
new attempt must clear stale task27 review state when core state is missing, idle or invalid
required_runtime_behaviour: task27 review-state reset guard in T123-06
invariants.official_total: official expert assessment remains conceptually distinct from the displayed demo result
invariants.essay_criterion_help: optional expandable student-facing guidance for K1-K10, aligned to the current year's criteria
invariants.displayed_demo_total: after essay self-assessment: short-part score + essay self-assessment, out of the current year's total; clearly labeled as based on user essay assessment
invariants.task27_spelling_check: explicit user action; spelling candidates are advisory and never auto-confirmed
invariants.student_facing_copy: plain Russian; no internal analyzer terms such as confirmed/possible/findings/hard cap in student UI
invariants.task27_check_trigger: explicit button only; typing/editing saves text and updates word count but performs no analysis
invariants.task27_analysis_invalidation: any edit after a check resets analysis/results for K7-K10 until the button is pressed again
invariants.task27_check_state_scope: spelling-check status is bound to the current attempt startedAt token and must not leak into a new attempt
invariants.task27_external_check_disclosure: before/near the check button state that essay text is sent to Yandex Speller for spelling; images/scans are not sent
invariants.task27_findings_visual_state: confirmed-error block highlighted red only when non-empty; advisory/check block highlighted amber only when non-empty
invariants.task27_scan_files: multiple images/PDFs; images can be enlarged; files remain local and are not persisted across reload
invariants.task27_check_summary: count all attention items produced by the combined local/advisory layer, not only external spelling rows; never claim that no errors exist

required_regression_tests: real PREVIEW plus current Task27 T123 blocks
adjacent and context-dependent repetitions remain advisory, never auto-confirmed
space before punctuation remains technical and creates no K8 cap
demo frozen essay versus paper transferred text
new attempt clears stale task27 review state while running/finished reload preserves it
typing/transferring essay produces zero findings until explicit check button
editing after check invalidates K7-K10 analysis and requires re-check
new attempt cannot inherit spelling-check completion/status from previous attempt
combined check status counts local K8-K10/technical notices together with spelling candidates
multiple scan pages and per-page zoom
student UI hides internal analyzer terminology while internal scoring invariants remain enforced
whole-result card equals short-part score plus completed essay self-assessment and is labeled as user assessment
